name: elpis
description: A durable, self-hosted runtime for one persistent AI agent

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc && npm run copy-assets
scripts.copy-assets: rm -rf dist/console/public && mkdir -p dist/console/public && cp -r src/console/public/. dist/console/public/ && cp node_modules/marked/lib/marked.umd.js dist/console/public/marked.umd.js && cp node_modules/prettier/standalone.js dist/console/public/prettier-standalone.js && cp node_modules/prettier/plugins/babel.js dist/console/public/prettier-babel.js && cp node_modules/prettier/plugins/estree.js dist/console/public/prettier-estree.js && cp node_modules/prettier/plugins/typescript.js dist/console/public/prettier-typescript.js && cp node_modules/prismjs/prism.js dist/console/public/prism.js && cp node_modules/prismjs/components/prism-typescript.min.js dist/console/public/prism-typescript.js && cp dist/lib/heredoc-display.js dist/console/public/heredoc-display.js && cp dist/lib/jslex.js dist/console/public/jslex.js
scripts.deploy: npm run build && systemctl --user restart elpis-harness && systemctl --user status elpis-harness --no-pager

author: Ava Chaney
